reason: My register has never crashed on me in all these years, and every bill I need is in it. The money isn't the problem, but I'm not moving my whole counter onto phones just because someone shows me a live view of my chairs.
objection: If the app hangs or a stylist's phone dies in the middle of the Sunday rush, who picks up the phone and fixes it? And I've already lost two good stylists, so I don't want the rest feeling watched or fumbling with an English app in front of customers.
would_change_my_mind: A named local person in Bhubaneswar who comes to the salon the same day when something breaks, plus a free month where I keep my register alongside the app and can see the drawer cash really matches.
